name: Citadels
summary: Role-drafting city-building card game where players secretly pick characters to gain gold, draw districts, and be first to build eight.
rules_text: Setup each player with 4 district cards and 2 gold; oldest player gets Crown. Each round: discard 1 character facedown and some faceup (by player count, never King faceup). Crown player secretly picks a character from the remaining deck and passes the rest left until each has one and one remains facedown. Crown then calls characters in rank order 1-8. On your call, reveal and take a turn unless assassinated. Turn: first take 2 gold OR draw 2 district cards keep 1 discard 1 to bottom, then optionally build one district from hand paying its cost, never duplicating a name in your city. Use your character's power once. Return characters, reshuffle. When someone builds their 8th district, finish the round and score total building costs plus 3 for having all five colors plus 4 for first to 8 or 2 for other 8-builders; most points wins, tiebreak by building cost then gold.
rating_reason: Role selection with hidden information and bluffing perfect fit
reasons: capability: conditional_subsequence: the step list is flat: a whole BLOCK of steps cannot be chosen instead of another block. This is NOT a limit on conditional scoring or conditional updates: a single step can carry a `when` condition and a single operation an `if`, both arithmetic, so 'the poisoner scores if the choices match, otherwise the chooser' is fine
